notes.title: Emotes and Weeklies!
notes.content:
Anewed feeling to be at the table of Saláta!
- New feature: Emoting, communication now allowed at the table
- New feature: Weeklies, earn more saláta coins through out the week!
- Many bug fixes!

There were a couple of changes in regards to:
- Network stabilization, and connectivity issues
- To the new custom looks
- And to card play rules

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
Gather now Saláta points, that you can spend in the store to obtain either card backs or poof effects!
Also if you happened to logged in and play a game of Saláta on your favourite holidays, you may obtain a cool cardback! 

Thank you for playing!

notes.content:
First update is live now!

[h2]Save & Play on Your Schedule![/h2]
You can now save your solo games when you quit, so you don’t have to play an entire match in one go. Pick up right where you left off, on your own time!

Plus, we’ve squashed some minor bugs and added a special "Thank You" cardback for our amazing supporters, which you can earn right after your first completed game session!

Thank you for reading, and happy gaming!
